title: Electric vs Diesel Concrete Pump When the Site Has Power
seoTitle: Electric vs Diesel Concrete Pump on Grid Sites | Pinjin
description: When three-phase power exists, start from the electric table — Electric 40 is 45 kW / 21 m³/h. Diesel 50 is 99 kW / 30 m³/h for sites that cannot feed that motor. This is not the off-grid diesel guide.
secondaryKeywords: diesel trailer pump when grid exists

relatedPaths.label: Diesel concrete pump for sites without electricity

answerBlock.what: If the site can feed the listed motor, we open the electric trailer table first: Electric 40 is 45 kW / 21 m³/h / 23 MPa. Diesel 50 is 6105 / 99 kW / 30 m³/h / 30 MPa for jobs that cannot hold that grid. Alibaba’s buying-guide FAQ says electric pumps on remote sites need reliable grid or a large generator; otherwise diesel is more practical. Indoor and tunnel jobs also have to account for diesel exhaust — Pinjin does not publish a ventilation rate.
answerBlock.who: Buyers who already have 380 V (or the listed kW) and are being offered a diesel trailer as a default export SKU.
factors: Listed motor kW versus site voltage/frequency
Whether a generator is actually sized — we do not publish generator kVA
Diesel exhaust indoors or underground (confirm ventilation; no invented ppm)
Output and distance still have to match the printed pair

faqs.question: If the site already has 380 V, should I still buy a diesel trailer?
faqs.answer: Not as a default. Match the electric row that fits output and distance — Electric 40 lists 45 kW and 21 m³/h. Choose diesel when the grid cannot feed the listed motor, or when the buyer states a generator will not be provided. A diesel catalogue row is not an electric-catalogue substitute.

faqs.question: Are electric pumps viable on remote job sites?
faqs.answer: Alibaba’s buying-guide FAQ: only if reliable grid or a large generator is available; otherwise diesel is more practical. Pinjin does not publish generator sizing. Send site voltage/frequency or state diesel. Rural diesel 17 kW and Diesel 30 (56 kW) are the compact/off-grid end of our diesel ladder — see the no-electricity guide for that job, not this page.

faqs.question: Can I run a diesel pump inside a basement or tunnel?
faqs.answer: The machine will run if fuel and exhaust routing are the contractor’s responsibility. We do not publish ventilation air changes or emission certificates. For enclosed pours with a listed grid, we discuss electric trailers. Spraying machines have a separate diesel sprayer (28/32 HP) when there is no 380 V.
